name: forsaken-bedrock-addon
description: FORSAKEN: Bedrock Edition - unofficial fan-made Minecraft Bedrock addon. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FORSAKEN developers or Roblox.

scripts.build: node tools/generate.mjs && node tools/build.mjs && npm run completeness && node tools/package.mjs
scripts.completeness: vitest run tests/data.test.ts tests/packs.test.ts tests/bots.test.ts -t "roster data|kits|generated packs|bot profiles"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run validate
